ram.note: Simplified from the UK Recyclability Assessment Methodology (PackUK). A rating stated in the recyclability result always wins; unassessed packaging is Red, as under RAM.

ppwr_grade.note: Design-for-recycling grades from the recyclable share of the packaging unit (Regulation (EU) 2025/40, Article 6): A from 95%, B from 80%, C from 70%. Below C fails from 2030. The D and E split and the caps per result are indicative until the delegated acts are adopted.

recycled_content.note: Minimum recycled content in plastic packaging from 2030 (Regulation (EU) 2025/40, Article 7), per packaging unit; units whose plastic is under 5% of their weight are exempt.
